data.body: [P1] This rejects the registry state produced by the workflow being replaced. Previously, the version manifest used x86_64→arm64 order while `latest` used arm64→x86_64, so their order-sensitive OCI digests differ and the `latest` digest has no `vX.Y.Z` tag. The first testing release after merge therefore exits here and reruns remain stuck. Bootstrap by matching legacy child-platform digests and retagging the exact version manifest, or migrate `latest` before enabling this guard.
